label: Search Response status field
type: the child object reporting whether a Search request succeeded, failed, or partially succeeded (status 200 with an errors object, if one or more index partitions failed to respond).
evidence: A Full Text Search Response Object is composed of multiple child objects that provides important information.
If one or more of the index partitions failed to cater to the request, the user can see partial results. In such a case, the response status is shown as 200, and the errors object
relates_to_competency_question: Can a Search query report partial success, and how does a client tell that apart from full success or full failure?
